verdict.rationale: CIPO is an IP office portal with online filing, MyCIPO accounts and searchable databases, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of service. Nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated insights or suggestions. The 'tailored guide' for IP strategy is not described as AI-driven or as built from the user's own data, so it is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
